test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the letters of the word UNDERSTANDING are arranged in the alphabetical order, then which of the following letter will be in the centre?
solution:
The letters of the word UNDERSTANDING when arranged in alphabetical order will be as follows:

__
 
• UNDERSTANDING → ADDEGINNNRSTU

The letter in the centre will be:

 
• ADDEGI**N**__NNRSTU

Hence, N will be in the centre.
